name: Alice complete-item revenue by month
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month, SUM(sale_price) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status='Complete' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: Bob complete-item revenue by month
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month, SUM(sale_price) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE status='Complete' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: Alice product comparison
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(*) AS items, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status='Complete' THEN i.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id,p.name ORDER BY p.id

name: Alice customer-state spend
sql: SELECT u.state, COUNT(DISTINCT i.customer_key) AS customers, SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN users u ON i.customer_key=u.customer_key WHERE i.status='Complete' GROUP BY u.state
privacy_expectation: Suppress state aggregate: four distinct customers are below the default minimum cohort size of five.

name: Alice scoped orders
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders

name: Bob authorized catalogue
sql: SELECT id,name FROM products ORDER BY id
